speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
question: What never sets, and who dwells within it?
premises: Never-setting light-form of bright powers and darknesses — darkness included, not opposed (api).
One within, in whom powers and darknesses end (yadantaḥ: limit and abode both).
inference: The all-containing One: light that never sets, holding bright and dark.
uncertainties: yadantaḥ read as limit and abode both — verse lets both stand.
